title: When was it built?
goal: Say what was done, and by whom, with the passive: yapıldı, bulundu, ertelendi, tarafından.

intro.text: The passive goes right after the stem: `-Il` after most consonants (*yapıldı*, it was built), `-In` after l (*bulundu*), *-n* after a vowel (*tamamlandı*). *Tarafından* names who did it: *Mimar Sinan tarafından yapıldı*.

vocab.en: to be found; to be (somewhere), to be located

exercises.explain: After the consonant p, the passive is `-Il`, here *-ıl*: *yap-ıl-dı*. `-In` is only for stems in l.

reject.why: After l the passive is `-In`, not `-Il`: *bul-un-du*.
*Buldu* is **she found** (it). For **was found**, add the passive: *bul-un-du*.

exercises.explain: *bul-* ends in l, so the passive is *-un*: *bul-un-du*.

exercises.question: Which sentence means **The meeting has been postponed**?

why.1: *Toplantıyı erteledi* is active: **he postponed the meeting**.
why.2: A meeting can't postpone anything: the verb needs the passive *-n*.

exercises.explain: *ertele-* ends in a vowel, so the passive is *-n*: *ertele-n-di*. The object becomes the subject and drops its accusative.

exercises.label: *seçilmek*, past: I was chosen, you were chosen…
exercises.explain: The passive *seç-il-* is a new stem, and the past endings follow as usual: *seç-il-di-m*.

exercises.prompt: This bridge was built in the 16th century.
accept: Bu köprü on altıncı yüzyılda yapıldı.
Bu köprü [16.|on altıncı] yüzyılda [inşa edildi|yapılmış|inşa edilmiş].

reject.why: *Yaptı* is active: the bridge would be the builder. **Was built**: *yap-ıl-dı*.

exercises.prompt: Bu cami Mimar Sinan tarafından yapıldı.
accept: This mosque was built by Mimar Sinan.
This mosque was [designed|made] by (the architect) [Mimar Sinan|Sinan].
This mosque was built by (the architect) Sinan.
This mosque was built by Sinan the Architect.

exercises.text: Eski bina ___, yerine bir park yapılacak.
exercises.en: The old building was pulled down; a park will be built in its place.
exercises.explain: *yık-ıl-dı*: the building didn't knock anything down, it **was** knocked down. *Yapılacak* shows that the passive takes the future too.

exercises.prompt: We were invited to a wedding.

reject.why: *Davet ettik* is active: **we invited**. **We were invited**: *davet edildik*.

exercises.question: What does the visitor want to know?

context.tr: Bu köprü 16. yüzyılda yapıldı. Taşları çok eski.
context.en: This bridge was built in the 16th century. Its stones are very old.

exercises.explain: *Kim tarafından yapıldı?*: **by whom was it built?** *Tarafından* names the doer of a passive verb.

accept: The hotel is right next to the sea.
The hotel is right [by|beside] the sea.
The hotel is located right [next to|by|beside|on] the sea.
The hotel is (located) [next to|by|beside|on] the sea.
The hotel is right on the sea.
